name: lean
description: omp-style token savers: hashline edits, trimmed tool output, a Haiku scout agent, optional push and mount guards, and a /lean report

trimChars.title: Trim output over (characters)
trimChars.description: Bash and Grep output longer than this keeps its head and tail; the full text is saved to a file

protectBranch.title: Protected branch
protectBranch.description: Refuse git pushes to this branch (for example main, where a push deploys). Empty turns the guard off

pushNote.title: Why the branch is protected
pushNote.description: Shown to Claude when a push is refused, for example: a push to main deploys

mountGuardPath.title: Compose folder to guard
mountGuardPath.description: Refuse single-file bind mounts in YAML files whose path contains this, for example deploy/compose/. Empty turns the guard off
